goal: Every public VII slider with arrows follows the approved non-looping boundary behavior on every route, language and supported viewport without changing unrelated product behavior.

intent_model.literal_request: Apply the arrow behavior to every slider everywhere on the site and on every page that contains a slider with arrows.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A user never sees or can activate an arrow that cannot move the current slider, and every slider behaves predictably like the approved homepage reference.
likely_rejections: Only homepage or one slider type was changed.
The arrow is visually faded but still active.
Mobile, RTL, LTR, loading or resize states were omitted.
The interaction fix changed approved content or layout.

interpretation_rules.phrase: every slider everywhere on the site
interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory every distinct public implementation with previous and next arrows, including rails and indexed image galleries.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: No representative sampling may replace the complete source inventory; every family member needs evidence or a documented exclusion.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Use real boundary-aware, non-looping navigation with native disabled state.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Initial, moved, terminal, non-overflowing and touch states must match the approved behavior.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The user sees only arrows that can currently move the slider.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Move toward the next or previous available item.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Continue browsing or open the selected card or image.
deferred_complexity: Geometry observation, direction handling and async-content reconciliation
preserved_depth: Localized labels and all existing destinations

actors: Public VII visitor using pointer, keyboard or touch
natural_destination: The exact deployed VII public routes that render homepage rails, event rails, search discovery, result cards, place galleries, story galleries and sleeping arrangements.

facts.claim: The homepage rail family already uses geometry-derived boundary state.
Several other public slider implementations still scroll without boundary state or use modulo index wraparound.
facts.evidence: Source inventory in event-rail.tsx, search-after-results.tsx, sleeping-arrangements.tsx, property-card.tsx, property-gallery.tsx and gallery-experience.tsx

assumptions.claim: Components that horizontally scroll but expose no previous or next arrows are outside this interaction change.
assumptions.validation: The final source inventory separately lists arrow-bearing sliders and horizontal navigation strips without arrows.

in_scope: Shared geometry-based boundary state for every arrow-controlled content rail
Clamped non-looping navigation for every arrow-controlled indexed image gallery
Native disabled attributes and visible disabled styles
Pointer, keyboard, touch, RTL, LTR, resize, loading, empty and terminal states
Automated and live production family verification
out_of_scope: Calendar month navigation, which is not a content slider
Horizontal tabs, chip rows and navigation strips that expose no slider arrows
DNS cutover, indexation changes and unrelated launch blockers
A visual redesign of cards, galleries or page sections
invariants: Existing card content, ordering, links, imagery and section hierarchy remain unchanged.
Touch scrolling and gallery swiping remain available but cannot wrap beyond a boundary.
Existing localization and text direction remain intact.
Booking, contact, supplier and analytics behavior remain unchanged.
affected_family: Vacation and event place hero galleries
Vacation, event and discovery story galleries
Hebrew, English, Russian and French public routes

requirements.statement: Every arrow-bearing content rail reports and enforces its actual start and end boundaries.
Every arrow-bearing indexed image gallery uses clamped navigation and never wraps between first and last images.
requirements.source: User request and approved reference behavior

requirements.statement: Boundary behavior remains correct after async content, resize, scrolling, touch and direction changes.
The change is published and verified across the complete affected family without altering unrelated product behavior.
requirements.source: User request and VII release standard

acceptance_checks.setup: An overflowing public rail is at its initial boundary.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect the controls, activate next once and continue to the terminal boundary.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Previous is initially disabled, becomes enabled after real movement, and next becomes disabled at the terminal boundary.

acceptance_checks.setup: A rail is loading, empty or has no horizontal overflow.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect and attempt to activate both controls.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Both arrows are natively disabled and the rail does not move.

acceptance_checks.setup: An image gallery contains more than one image and is at the first image.
acceptance_checks.action: Use arrows and swipes to navigate to both boundaries and repeat the boundary action.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The previous arrow is disabled on the first image, next is disabled on the last image, and repeated arrow or swipe actions never wrap.

acceptance_checks.setup: A representative route is loaded in RTL and an LTR language at desktop and 390 pixels.
acceptance_checks.action: Reload, resize and interact with the slider.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The correct visual arrow is disabled for the logical previous direction, states refresh from rendered geometry and no document overflow appears.

acceptance_checks.setup: A production candidate has passed automated and local browser checks.
acceptance_checks.action: Publish once, record the immutable version and repeat representative family checks on the public URL.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The exact deployed version passes, a rollback version is recorded and existing routes, content and destinations remain available.

acceptance_checks.setup: A boundary is reached or the slider has no movable content.
acceptance_checks.action: Attempt pointer, keyboard and repeated touch activation toward the unavailable direction.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No index or scroll position changes, no duplicate navigation fires and the available opposite direction remains usable.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, testing and publication to the already authorized temporary production site are permitted. DNS, indexing and unrelated product changes are excluded.
